verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect. Mistral sells secure on-prem/self-hosted deployments of Document AI, and OCR 4 can run in a single container that keeps document data in your own environment. That gives customers de facto control over retention, but only by running it themselves. Nothing documents retention settings or deletion controls for the hosted API, including for uploaded files. missing for 10: documented retention policy or zero-data-retention option for the hosted API, an API or UI for deleting uploaded documents and outputs, configurable retention periods, independent corroboration.
